question: In 1942, the British government sent the _______ mission to India.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Cripps.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cripps mission** was sent by the** British government** to **India** in **1942.**
 
• The mission was led by **Sir Stafford Cripps,** a senior British politician, and aimed to** secure Indian support** for the British war effort during** World War II.**
 
• The mission proposed a plan for **Indian independence after the war**, but with conditions that were **unacceptable **to Indian political leaders, leading to its failure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Linlithgow** was the** Viceroy of India** from **1936 to 1943.**

 
 
• He played a key role in India's participation in **World War II**, including the **Quit India movement **and the **Cripps mission**.
 
 
 
• **Cabinet **refers to the **British government** as a whole, which was responsible for decisions related to India during the colonial period.
 
• **Lansdowne** refers to Lord Lansdowne.
 
 
• He served as** Viceroy of India** from **1888 to 1894**, and was involved in several important reforms and policies during his tenure.
